name: Qreative Header Footer Designer
author: QreativeThemes

sections.description:
Qreative Header Footer Designer lets you build custom WordPress headers and footers with Elementor, without needing a full theme builder setup.

Create a dedicated header or footer template, design it visually in Elementor, then choose where it should appear across your website. You can show a template site-wide, target common WordPress views, or include and exclude specific pages and posts.

The plugin is built for classic WordPress themes that need a clean, focused way to replace the theme header or footer with Elementor-designed layouts.

📌 Why Use Qreative Header Footer Designer?

  • 🎨 Visual Elementor editing: Build headers and footers with the Elementor editor you already know.
  • 🧩 Theme layout control: Replace theme header and footer areas without editing theme files.
  • 📐 Separate template types: Create dedicated templates for headers and footers.
  • 🎯 Display conditions: Control where each template appears across your site.
  • 📄 Page-specific targeting: Include or exclude specific pages and posts when you need more precise layouts.
  • 📌 Sticky header support: Add sticky header behavior from the template settings.
  • 🧰 Header widgets included: Use purpose-built Elementor widgets for common header elements.
  • ⚡ Elementor CSS handling: Keep Elementor template CSS loading correctly on the frontend.
  • 🌐 Multilingual support: Translate templates with WPML or Polylang.

📋 Best For

Qreative Header Footer Designer is useful for designers, agencies, freelancers, and site owners who want more control over classic theme layouts.

🏢 Business Websites

Create a polished header with your logo, navigation, and search overlay, then pair it with a branded footer that fits the rest of the site.

🚀 Landing Pages

Use page-specific display conditions to show a cleaner header or footer on selected campaign pages, service pages, or sales pages.

🌐 Multilingual Websites

Build header and footer templates that work with WPML or Polylang, including page-specific display logic for translated content.

🤝 Client Websites

Give clients a visual way to manage header and footer layouts with Elementor, while keeping the template controls organized in a dedicated admin area.

✨ Feature Overview

🧱 Header and Footer Templates

Create templates specifically for your site header or footer. Each template has its own settings, status, and display rules, so you can manage layouts without digging through theme files.

🎨 Elementor Editing

Design your template with Elementor and use the widgets, sections, columns, containers, and styling controls you already know.

🎯 Display Conditions

Choose where each header or footer should appear. You can display templates across the entire website or target common WordPress contexts such as:

  • Front page
  • Blog page
  • Pages
  • Posts
  • Archives
  • Search results
  • 404 page

You can also include or exclude specific pages and posts for more control.

📌 Sticky Header Support

Enable sticky header behavior from the template settings when you want the header to stay visible while visitors scroll.

🧰 Elementor Widgets Included

Qreative Header Footer Designer includes focused Elementor widgets for building practical headers:

  • 🖼️ Qreative: Site Logo
  • 🧭 Qreative: Menu
  • 🔎 Qreative: Search Overlay

🖼️ Site Logo Widget

Display your WordPress site logo in an Elementor-built header. The widget uses your existing site identity settings, so the logo stays connected to WordPress.

🧭 Menu Widget

Add a WordPress navigation menu to your header and style it inside Elementor. The widget works with menus created under Appearance > Menus.

🔎 Search Overlay Widget

Add a clean search trigger that opens an overlay search experience, useful for compact headers and modern navigation layouts.

⚡ Elementor CSS Handling

The plugin makes sure Elementor template CSS is loaded correctly on the frontend, helping your header and footer designs display as expected.

🌐 Multilingual Compatibility

Qreative Header Footer Designer supports WPML and Polylang workflows for translated header and footer templates.

⚙️ Requirements

This plugin requires Elementor to be installed and active.

Qreative Header Footer Designer is built primarily for classic WordPress themes. Block themes include their own Site Editor workflow, so results can vary depending on the active block theme.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/qreative-header-footer-designer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Go to Qreative Header Footer Designer in the WordPress admin.
  5. Create a new template and choose whether it should be used as a header or footer.
  6. Edit the template with Elementor and publish it.

🚦 Getting Started

🧱 Create a Custom Header

  1. Go to Qreative Header Footer Designer > Add New.
  2. Choose Header as the template type.
  3. Publish the template.
  4. Click Edit with Elementor.
  5. Build your header with the included Qreative widgets or any Elementor widgets.
  6. Return to the template settings and choose where the header should display.

🧩 Create a Custom Footer

  1. Go to Qreative Header Footer Designer > Add New.
  2. Choose Footer as the template type.
  3. Publish the template.
  4. Click Edit with Elementor.
  5. Build your footer layout with Elementor.
  6. Return to the template settings and choose where the footer should display.

🎯 Target Specific Pages or Posts

  1. Open a header or footer template.
  2. In Display Conditions, choose Select Pages / Posts.
  3. Search for the pages or posts where the template should appear.
  4. Use Exclude Specific Pages / Posts to prevent the template from showing on selected content.
sections.faq:
⚙️ Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and active because the header and footer templates are edited with Elementor.

🧱 Does this plugin work with block themes?

Qreative Header Footer Designer is built primarily for classic WordPress themes. Block themes already include their own Site Editor system, so results can vary depending on the theme.

🧭 Can I use my existing WordPress menus?

Yes. The Qreative: Menu widget lets you select menus created under Appearance > Menus.

📌 Can I make my header sticky?

Yes. Sticky header behavior can be enabled in the template settings.

🎯 Can I show a header or footer only on certain pages?

Yes. You can use display conditions to show templates across the full site, on common WordPress views, or on selected pages and posts.

🚫 Can I exclude a page from a global header or footer?

Yes. Use the exclude option in the display conditions to prevent a template from appearing on selected pages or posts.

🧰 Does the plugin include widgets for building headers?

Yes. The free plugin includes Elementor widgets for the site logo, menu, and search overlay.

🌐 Does it support multilingual websites?

Yes. Builder templates and page-specific display conditions are compatible with WPML and Polylang.
